work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind coverage audit of the already-used pinned Claw-SWE-Bench same-model harness table. Existing neutral evidence stored OpenClaw and Hermes Agent for the GLM 5.1 and Qwen 3.6-flash groups. The pinned public leaderboard contains three additional claws under the same Full-350 fixed-model cells; this pass admits those six missing rows while reusing the four existing observations.

source_known_dimensions: same Full-350 task set and 350-instance denominator
same Docker runtime family and official SWE-bench evaluator
fresh per-instance execution containers for the newly admitted adapters
benchmark explicitly defines this as the Same Model × Different Claws table
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: historical ZeroClaw, NanoBot and GenericAgent package/source revisions are not pinned by the inspected snapshot
canonical OpenSiro linkage is absent for ZeroClaw, NanoBot and GenericAgent
harness-native prompts, tool surfaces and control policies differ by the independent variable
GenericAgent receives a benchmark-specific prompt-level web-tool prohibition because upstream lacks a config-level disable
ZeroClaw uses a benchmark tool-filter/config proxy membrane
model endpoint/provider configuration details beyond the published fixed-model identity require downstream comparability review
